label: MONEY QUOTE
hook: Savings grow on patience, not on luck.

slides.text: No one builds savings in a single month.
slides.sub: It's small amounts, again and again

slides.text: ₹500 a week becomes ₹26,000 in a year.
The secret isn't a lucky break. It's showing up every single week.
Try this today: fix a weekly amount you'll save, even if it's small.
